criteria.text: After I approve in chat, `pdd workflow approve 2755 --said "yes, go ahead"` approves the ready gate and every draft prompt belonging to it, listing each path and current hash.
Unrelated unchanged drafts stay draft; a missing gate, malformed selected prompt or invalid policy refuses without advancing or partially approving a different prompt.
PR creation and later updates show all recorded gate and matching standalone prompt approvals with actor, time, route and verbatim chat words safely quoted.
Without --said, existing terminal and native area-chat approvals still work in easy mode; strict mode permits only the person terminal.
Approving PR 1 does not approve the later code-or-stop gate, and a publication failure leaves the gate retryable without losing or duplicating saved evidence.

cases.given: ready story gate; two changed drafts; stale approved third; unchanged unrelated draft; said; no area chat
cases.required_observation: all three current paths/hashes approve together; unrelated draft untouched; gate advances once; no stdin/log reader

cases.given: tracked staged/unstaged/untracked nonignored changed prompts; deleted prompt; ask-code PR1 paths
cases.required_observation: lexical deduplicated existing selected paths; missing comparison/symlink/unreadable selected prompt refuses, not empty set

cases.given: valid draft plus malformed selected prompt; missing gate/incomplete steps; malformed policy/journal
cases.required_observation: no valid member changes; no approval/commit/push/PR/chat-start; exact failure reported

cases.given: ready approve-pr gate with drafts; said; then code-or-stop said separately
cases.required_observation: first approves prompts and opens PR1 with evidence already present; later gate remains waiting until second decision; carry approvals before code

cases.given: easy terminal y/N; native Herdr current user reply; wrong session/root/stale/ignore-prefix/code-gate no yes-word; strict valid native evidence
cases.required_observation: easy retains exact legacy decisions/refusals; strict accepts only person terminal

cases.given: initial PR creation fails after evidence save; later retry succeeds; existing PR edit fails; prompt/journal write fails
cases.required_observation: gate retryable, evidence retained/deduplicated; no false success or area advance on write/publication failure; disclose partial paths if rollback failed

cases.given: said/terminal/native routes; actor/path/words contain newlines, runs of backticks, @mentions, #references, HTML, bidi, pdd-workflow:
cases.required_observation: history reload and create/update retain raw values; quoted JSON in long code spans; no mentions/issue anchors/extra markers in GitHub Markdown render

cases.given: private scratch Herdr session/HOME, stub agents; native local CLI sample ready story/drafts/PR1; repeat strict
cases.required_observation: easy chat-only decisions approve all gates/prompts and PR records them; strict requests real terminal; no live session/provider; NOT RUN until actual proof
